4408d8c38a817dc874cbcff07f4a5dc25081c09f.title: Dreams Are Cheaper Than Flights: Curated World-Model Data Improves Aerial Detection
4408d8c38a817dc874cbcff07f4a5dc25081c09f.summary: Robot perception is increasingly data driven, yet field data is slow, costly, and sometimes disruptive to collect. Video world models offer a cheaper source: seeded with real frames, they extend a recorded scene into new footage with the deployment's sensor, altitude, and environment. We ask whether such synthetic data matches the utility of real field data and whether detectors trained with it perform in the field. Seeding a 7B-parameter world model with wildlife drone video, we more than double the training set with curated frames. On held-out videos from the same drones, mAP@50--95 rises 4.3\% when these frames are added to real data and 10.3\% when they replace it, and up to 33.5\% on an urban benchmark. Although an expert rejects an estimated 87.5\% of generated clips, the data costs about \$1,100 of GPU time, against more than \$3,200 of field labor alone for a less useful real training set. Synthetic data thus shifts data costs from fieldwork to compute.

AI.tldr: 用7B视频世界模型在真实无人机帧上生成并筛选合成帧，把训练集扩大一倍以上；在未见过的同型无人机视频上mAP@50--95提升4.3%（叠加真实数据）或10.3%（替换真实数据），城市基准上最高33.5%。
AI.motivation: 机器人感知依赖数据，但野外数据采集慢、贵且有时具破坏性；作者想验证视频世界模型生成的合成数据能否在效用上媲美真实野外数据，以及用其训练的检测器能否在实地工作。
AI.method: 输入是用真实帧“播种”的视频世界模型：以野生动物无人机视频为种子，让7B参数世界模型把已录场景延展成带有部署传感器、高度与环境特征的新片段，并经过人工筛选保留帧。输出是扩充后的训练集——作者用它把训练集扩大一倍以上，再训练检测器，并与仅用真实数据、以及用真实数据叠加合成帧的设定对比。
AI.result: 作者报告：在来自同一批无人机的留出视频上，加入合成帧使mAP@50--95提升4.3%（叠加真实数据）与10.3%（替换真实数据），在城市基准上最高提升33.5%。成本方面，数据约花费\$1,100的GPU时间，而“效用更低的真实训练集”仅野外人工就超过\$3,200。作者未在摘要中给出绝对mAP数值、基线检测器名称或样本规模。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型研究而言，该摘要提示世界模型可把数据成本从野外作业转移到算力，并可作为检测器训练数据的补充或替代来源；但证据仅限于检测指标与成本对比，是否对应真实机器人实地部署、生成数据的失败模式细节等均未在摘要中说明。
AI.core_method: 用真实无人机帧播种7B视频世界模型生成新片段，经人工筛选后扩充检测器训练集。

key_results.finding: 在同一批无人机的留出视频上，加入世界模型合成帧使mAP@50--95相对提升4.3%（叠加真实数据）、10.3%（替换真实数据）。
key_results.setting: 任务为无人机航拍野生动物检测；评测数据为来自同一批无人机的留出视频；基线为真实数据训练集（叠加或替换两种设定）；摘要未报告绝对mAP值、检测器架构与样本量。
key_results.evidence_quote: On held-out videos from the same drones, mAP@50--95 rises 4.3\% when these frames are added to real data and 10.3\% when they replace it

key_results.finding: 合成数据约花费\$1,100的GPU时间，而效用更低的真实训练集仅野外人工成本就超过\$3,200。
key_results.setting: 成本对比：GPU算力开销 vs 野外人工开销；摘要未报告算力与人工的计价口径、工时数或时间范围。
key_results.evidence_quote: the data costs about \$1,100 of GPU time, against more than \$3,200 of field labor alone for a less useful real training set

limitations: 作者自述的质量限制：专家估计拒收了约87.5%的生成片段（摘要原文：“an expert rejects an estimated 87.5\% of generated clips”）。
摘要未报告：检测器架构、训练超参、绝对mAP数值、样本量与统计显著性检验。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

ce9723800fe2e22bb177601e334248cf69f2368f.title: WorkIng: A Real-World and Synthetic Highway Work-Zone Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Navigation
ce9723800fe2e22bb177601e334248cf69f2368f.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 19 pages including supplementary material. (c) 2027 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted
ce9723800fe2e22bb177601e334248cf69f2368f.summary: Highway work zones are critical edge cases for autonomous vehicles (AVs), combining atypical geometries and jurisdiction-specific regulations that existing benchmarks fail to capture: real-world datasets lack 360° multi-modal, full-scene 3D work zone annotation, and no single recorded site can span the layouts and regulatory variants needed for generalizable models. We present WorkIng, a dual-domain benchmark and training resource. WorkIng-Highway provides a 360° multi-modal work zone benchmark with synchronized 128-channel LiDAR, six RGB cameras, and RTK-GPS across 32 km, yielding 12,000+ annotated frames and 227,399 tracked 3D bounding boxes. WorkIng-CARLA complements this with procedural simulation spanning 24 regulation-aware scenarios across six canonical topologies and six international traffic standards, populated by 100+ custom 3D assets. Benchmarking representative 3D detection and end-to-end planning architectures shows that real-world data remains the primary performance driver, and that scenario-stratified synthetic augmentation improves architectures across 2D recognition, 3D detection, and trajectory planning. Resources: this https URL

AI.tldr: WorkIng 提出一个"真实+仿真"双域的高速公路作业区基准与训练资源：真实域提供 360° 多模态标注，仿真域提供规则感知的场景库；作者报告真实数据是性能主要驱动因素，且按场景分层的合成增强可提升 2D 识别、3D 检测与轨迹规划。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出高速公路作业区是自动驾驶的关键边缘场景，兼具非典型几何与地域性法规，而现有基准无法覆盖：真实数据集缺少 360° 多模态的全场景 3D 作业区标注，且单一记录场地无法覆盖可泛化模型所需的布局与法规变体。
AI.method: 输入是双域数据：WorkIng-Highway 采集真实高速公路作业区，含同步的 128 线 LiDAR、六个 RGB 相机与 RTK-GPS，覆盖 32 km，产出 12,000+ 标注帧与 227,399 个跟踪的 3D 边界框；WorkIng-CARLA 用程序化仿真补足，覆盖 24 个规则感知场景、六种典型拓扑与六套国际交通标准，使用 100+ 自定义 3D 资产。方法层面并未提出新网络，而是构建基准/训练资源，并用代表性 3D 检测与端到端规划架构进行对比，考察真实数据与按场景分层的合成增强各自的作用。输出是标注数据、仿真场景库以及在此之上的评测结果。
AI.result: 作者报告：在代表性 3D 检测与端到端规划架构上，真实世界数据仍是性能的主要驱动因素；按场景分层的合成增强可在 2D 识别、3D 检测与轨迹规划三类任务上改善架构。摘要未给出任何具体指标数值、提升幅度、单位或对比基线的量化结果，因此上述为作者的定性/相对性结论，而非可核验的数字。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与自动驾驶研究的意义在于：把作业区这类"几何非典型+法规相关"的边缘场景做成可复现的双域基准，使研究者能分离真实数据与仿真数据的贡献，并用法规/拓扑分层检验泛化。证据边界：摘要只给出数据规模与定性结论，未报告量化提升、未涉及真实车辆部署或闭环实车验证，资源链接也未在摘要中展开，故不能推断方法的实际部署效果。

key_results.finding: WorkIng-Highway 的规模：32 km 真实采集，产出 12,000+ 标注帧与 227,399 个跟踪 3D 边界框，具备 360° 多模态同步。
key_results.setting: 真实高速公路作业区采集；传感器为 128 线 LiDAR、六个 RGB 相机与 RTK-GPS；摘要未报告采集城市/时间、标注协议或数据划分。
key_results.evidence_quote: WorkIng-Highway provides a 360° multi-modal work zone benchmark with synchronized 128-channel LiDAR, six RGB cameras, and RTK-GPS across 32 km, yielding 12,000+ annotated frames and 227,399 tracked 3D bounding boxes.

key_results.finding: WorkIng-CARLA 的仿真覆盖：24 个规则感知场景、六种典型拓扑、六套国际交通标准，包含 100+ 自定义 3D 资产。
key_results.setting: 程序化仿真（CARLA）；摘要未报告场景清单、随机化设置或域差距量化。
key_results.evidence_quote: WorkIng-CARLA complements this with procedural simulation spanning 24 regulation-aware scenarios across six canonical topologies and six international traffic standards, populated by 100+ custom 3D assets.

key_results.finding: 在代表性 3D 检测与端到端规划架构上的结论：真实数据是主要性能驱动，按场景分层的合成增强在 2D 识别、3D 检测与轨迹规划上均有改善。
key_results.setting: 基准评测涵盖代表性 3D 检测与端到端规划架构；摘要未报告具体模型、指标名称、数值或提升幅度。
key_results.evidence_quote: Benchmarking representative 3D detection and end-to-end planning architectures shows that real-world data remains the primary performance driver, and that scenario-stratified synthetic augmentation improves architectures across 2D recognition, 3D detection, and trajectory planning.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中报告具体量化结果：无指标名称、无提升数值、无单位、无对照基线，因此“改善”与“主要驱动因素”均为定性表述，无法核验幅度。
摘要未报告真实车辆部署或闭环实车评估；所描述的是基准与训练资源，以及在其上的架构对比。
摘要未报告数据划分、标注质量/一致性、仿真与真实域差距的量化，以及所评测架构的具体清单（属摘要未报告信息，非作者声明的缺陷）。

a456ae88803824a0e2c5c652131f8df8de2de210.title: Flexibility-Aware Robotic Manipulation: Deformation Estimation, Kinematics, and Control via Distributed Inertial Measurement
a456ae88803824a0e2c5c652131f8df8de2de210.summary: Flexible robot links challenge the rigid-body assumption, making joint measurements alone insufficient for accurate manipulation. This paper introduces a flexibility-aware manipulation framework that connects structural dynamics directly to sensing, kinematics, and control. Instead of prescribing a dense inertial measurement unit (IMU) network, the dominant vibration modes of each flexible link are first identified from response-convergence and excitation-bandwidth criteria. Under a full-rank modal observability condition, $m$ retained modes require only $m$ independent slope measurements and one reference IMU, defining the minimum observable IMU configuration. The resulting measurements are used to reconstruct the continuous link deformation, which is then incorporated into flexibility-aware forward kinematics and a deformation-informed partial differential equation-based controller. Experiments on hydraulic single- and double-link manipulators evaluate the framework. On the long-reach double-link platform, the proposed kinematics achieves end-effector root mean square errors of $0.0107$~m, $0.0194$~m, and $0.0102$~rad while using fewer sensors than the piecewise-rigid method. Closed-loop reaching experiments further demonstrate real-time integration of IMU-estimated joint states and reconstructed deformation into the proposed controller. The results show that dominant modal information can determine sensing requirements and enable real-time flexibility-aware robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 柔性机械臂违背刚体假设，仅靠关节测量难以精确操作。作者用主导振动模态推出"最小可观测IMU配置"，据此重建连续连杆变形，并接入柔性感知正运动学与基于偏微分方程的控制器；在液压单/双连杆平台上报告末端RMSE为0.0107 m、0.0194 m、0.0102 rad，且传感器数量少于分段刚体方法。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出：柔性连杆使刚体假设失效，单独使用关节测量不足以实现准确操作。因此需要一个把结构动力学与传感、运动学、控制直接连起来的框架，而不是先验地铺设密集IMU网络。
AI.method: 输入：柔性连杆的响应与激励信息（由"响应收敛"和"激励带宽"准则筛选出各连杆的主导振动模态）。变化/学习对象：作者不规定密集IMU阵列，而是在满秩模态可观测条件下确定传感器配置——若保留m个模态，只需m个独立斜率测量加1个参考IMU，即最小可观测IMU配置；并用这些测量重建连续连杆变形。输出：把变形并入柔性感知正运动学，并送入"变形信息驱动的偏微分方程控制器"。相对于摘要中提到的分段刚体方法，核心差异是显式建模变形并使用更少传感器。
AI.result: 作者报告：在长臂双连杆平台上，所提运动学的末端RMSE为0.0107 m、0.0194 m、0.0102 rad，同时所用传感器少于分段刚体方法（摘要未给出该基线的数值RMSE）。闭环到达实验展示了将IMU估计的关节状态与重建变形实时纳入所提控制器。摘要自述结论为"主导模态信息可以决定传感需求并实现实时柔性感知机器人操作"，但未报告统计显著性、重复次数或更广泛平台上的数值对比。
AI.conclusion: 对柔性臂操作而言，该工作提出一条从模态分析到传感配置、再到运动学与控制的连贯路径，并用传感器数量与末端RMSE说明"按可观测性裁剪传感"可行。证据边界：仅摘要所述，实验限于液压单、双连杆机械臂，实时性以"闭环到达实验"给出定性说明，摘要未报告硬件型号、延迟数值、消融或真实部署之外的迁移验证。所有结论均为作者报告，未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 按主导振动模态的可观测性确定最少IMU布置（m个模态对应m个斜率测量加1个参考IMU），用这些测量重建连续连杆变形，并将其嵌入正运动学与偏微分方程控制器。

key_results.finding: 长臂双连杆平台上所提运动学末端RMSE为0.0107 m、0.0194 m、0.0102 rad，且使用的传感器少于分段刚体方法。
key_results.setting: 任务：长臂双连杆液压机械臂上的运动学精度评测；基线：分段刚体（piecewise-rigid）方法；条件：仅报告运动学误差，摘要未给出具体平台尺寸、传感器数量、采样条件或基线噪声水平。
key_results.evidence_quote: On the long-reach double-link platform, the proposed kinematics achieves end-effector root mean square errors of $0.0107$~m, $0.0194$~m, and $0.0102$~rad while using fewer sensors than the piecewise-rigid method.

key_results.finding: 闭环到达实验显示，IMU估计的关节状态与重建变形被实时纳入所提控制器。
key_results.setting: 任务：闭环到达（reaching）实验；平台：摘要所述液压单、双连杆机械臂；条件：摘要未报告控制周期、时延数值、到达精度指标或实时性量化定义。
key_results.evidence_quote: Closed-loop reaching experiments further demonstrate real-time integration of IMU-estimated joint states and reconstructed deformation into the proposed controller.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中报告明确的方法缺陷或失败情形（作者报告的限制：摘要未给出）。
摘要未报告：分段刚体基线的具体数值RMSE、传感器数量差值，因此无法量化相对改进幅度。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

f8c1ef24c1ca1e01c7b14510213fba5a8838689e.title: Confidence-Modulated Safety Filtering for End-to-End Policies
f8c1ef24c1ca1e01c7b14510213fba5a8838689e.summary: End-to-end policies, from task-specific controllers to robot foundation models, learn complex behavior from raw observations but are not guaranteed to remain safe, so they are often wrapped in a safety filter. The resulting system operates under two domains: the filter's operational design domain (ODD), where its assumptions hold and safety is certified, and the policy's competence domain, where it is reliable. Filters typically fix their conservativeness regardless of the policy's competence, trading performance inside the ODD against margin beyond it. We ask whether the policy's confidence should set that level, and propose a filter-agnostic pipeline that modulates it at runtime: inside the ODD, where every setting is safe, confidence buys performance; beyond it, low confidence adds margin, which helps when it flags where the filter's model fails. Preliminary F1TENTH simulations, where this holds, show the modulated filter combining the strengths of permissive and conservative filters.

AI.tldr: 端到端策略虽能从原始观测学到复杂行为，却无安全保障，通常需外接安全滤波器；作者提出一种与滤波器无关的流程，在运行时用策略置信度调节滤波器保守程度：在 ODD 内（所有设置都安全）高置信度换取性能，在 ODD 外低置信度增加安全余量。初步 F1TENTH 仿真显示该调制滤波器兼具宽松与保守滤波器之长，摘要未报告数值结果。
AI.motivation: 安全滤波器的保守程度通常被固定，与策略自身的能力无关，于是在滤波器运行设计域（ODD）内牺牲性能、在 ODD 外牺牲余量，形成一种静态权衡。作者据此提问：能否由策略的置信度来设定这一保守水平。
AI.method: 输入是端到端策略（从任务专用控制器到机器人基础模型）的观测/行为，以及包在外层的安全滤波器；方法不替换也不修改滤波器本身（filter-agnostic），而是在运行时调制其保守程度。依据是：在 ODD 内滤波器假设成立、所有设置都安全，因此置信度可用于换取性能；超出 ODD 时，低置信度被用来加大安全余量，其有效性取决于置信度能否标示出滤波器模型失效的位置。输出是经置信度调制后的安全滤波策略行为。摘要未说明置信度如何计算、如何映射为滤波参数，以及调制发生在策略还是滤波器接口上。
AI.result: 结果仅为定性结论：在 F1TENTH 仿真中，调制后的滤波器结合了宽松（permissive）与保守（conservative）滤波器的优点。摘要未报告任务指标、数值、单位或与基线的对比幅度，也未报告真机实验。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于提出把策略置信度当作策略能力域与滤波器 ODD 之间的调节信号，从而在安全与性能之间做运行时取舍，而无需改动滤波器本身。证据边界：作者仅称在 F1TENTH 仿真中"该假设成立"，属初步验证，摘要不含定量指标、真机部署或统计结论，因此不能推断其在真实机器人或更复杂任务上的有效性。
AI.core_method: 在运行时用端到端策略的置信度动态调高或调低外层安全滤波器的保守程度。

key_results.finding: 在 F1TENTH 仿真中，经置信度调制的滤波器结合了宽松滤波器与保守滤波器的优点；摘要未报告任何数值指标。
key_results.setting: 任务：端到端策略的安全滤波；环境：F1TENTH 仿真；对比对象：permissive 与 conservative 滤波器；具体指标、数值与真机条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Preliminary F1TENTH simulations, where this holds, show the modulated filter combining the strengths of permissive and conservative filters.

limitations: 作者自述为“Preliminary”级别：仅在 F1TENTH 仿真中验证，摘要未报告真机结果。
摘要未报告任何定量指标、基线数值、样本量或统计显著性。
摘要未报告置信度的定义与校准方式、ODD 与策略能力域的划分方法，以及“低置信度能标示滤波器模型失效”这一前提的验证细节；这些属摘要未报告，不代表方法缺乏相应能力。

425a0a8dc8ed640b7f271f2f8b3333d71c90bdac.title: Visual-Inertial RGB-D SLAM with Encoders for a Differential Wheeled Robot
425a0a8dc8ed640b7f271f2f8b3333d71c90bdac.comment: 11 pages. Author-accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Sensors Journal, 2022
425a0a8dc8ed640b7f271f2f8b3333d71c90bdac.summary: Recent years have seen multiple impressive results in visual-inertial odometry (VIO) techniques, by which accurate state estimation can be achieved via the extended Kalman filter (EKF) or nonlinear optimization. However, these approaches are rarely open source, and they tend to fail in real experiments due to the temporary lack of feature points and fast motion. Therefore, in this study, we used encoders to overcome the temporary failure of purely vision-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Here, we propose a generative measurement model for encoders and derive an expression for the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and necessary Jacobians for optimization. We use our theory to present a novel tightly coupled visual-inertial encoder RGB-Depth (RGB-D) SLAM system. Tests on our system on an in-house dataset confirmed that our modeling effort led to accurate (with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of approximately 2-7 cm) and robust state estimation in real time. The source code and our dataset containing the encoder information have been published for verification.

1efc659f614219f9909c3a002da537ad6e040521.title: Suspended-Fabric Robotic Manipulation Surfaces: Modelling, Design Space, and Multimodular Extensio
1efc659f614219f9909c3a002da537ad6e040521.summary: Robotic Manipulation Surfaces (RMS) reposition objects by deforming the surface on which they rest. A recent class of RMS suspends a continuous fabric sheet from a sparse grid of vertical linear actuators lowering the actuator density of such surfaces but how to design such surfaces so that objects can be controlled everywhere on it, and how to extend it beyond a single module so that objects can pass between modules and achieve parallel, remain open. This paper presents a separable catenary model of the suspended sheet that is fast to compute and provides both the surface shape for given actuator heights and the actuator heights for a desired local slope. The closed form inverse lets a simple PID controller position objects on the sheet, and the model relates fabric length, module span and actuator stroke to the reachable workspace, yielding a minimum fabric length bound and design charts for these surfaces. The approach is then extended to a multimodular platform in which neighbouring modules share actuators. On a $2 \times 2$ prototype, we demonstrate that centimetre-scale objects are transferred between modules and positioned within 0.03 m over a $1 m^2$ workspace with only nine actuators, enabling multi-object manipulation and opening the way to parallel manipulation.

AI.tldr: 该工作为"悬挂织物式机器人操作表面"建立可分离悬链线模型，给出正/逆闭式解并用于PID物体定位，再扩展为共享执行器的多模块平台；在2×2样机上将厘米级物体在1 m²范围内传递并定位到0.03 m以内，仅用九个执行器。
AI.motivation: 悬挂式操作表面用稀疏竖向直线执行器悬吊连续织物，降低了执行器密度，但摘要指出两个问题尚未解决：如何设计使物体在整个表面上都能被控制，以及如何扩展到单模块之外，使物体能在模块间传递并实现并行操作。
AI.method: 输入是给定的执行器高度或期望的局部坡度；方法建立织物的"可分离悬链线"模型，快速计算表面形状（正解）与达到期望局部坡度所需的执行器高度（闭式逆解）。据此外接一个简单PID控制器来定位表面上的物体，并把织物长度、模块跨度和执行器行程与可达工作空间联系起来，得到最小织物长度下界和设计图表。随后扩展到相邻模块共享执行器的多模块平台，输出为可在模块间传递物体的操作表面设计。
AI.result: 作者在2×2样机上报告：厘米级物体可在模块间传递，并在1 m²工作空间内以仅九个执行器实现0.03 m以内的定位精度，支持多物体操作并"为并行操作开辟道路"。摘要未报告与基线方法的对比、成功率或速度指标。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：用可解析的表面形变模型把"表面即操作器"的设计问题变成可计算的设计空间，并通过共享执行器的模块化实现物体跨模块传递与并行操作的雏形。证据边界：定位精度与执行器数量仅为2×2样机的自报结果，摘要未给出基线比较、定量验证的评测协议，也未说明该样机的物理/仿真属性之外的部署条件。
AI.core_method: 用可分离悬链线模型给出织物形状与执行器高度的闭式正逆解，驱动PID控制物体在悬挂织物表面上的运动。

key_results.setting: 2×2多模块样机；任务为模块间物体传递与表面定位；摘要未报告基线与成功率。

key_results.setting: 控制方法为PID，基于模型逆解；摘要未报告具体控制指标。

53528905936e1682818a7a90c35cc2b49a73ae98.title: Design and Validation of a Robotic Knee Exoskeleton with Musculoskeletal Simulation-Derived Biological Torque Control
53528905936e1682818a7a90c35cc2b49a73ae98.summary: Data-driven controllers have enabled lower-limb robotic exoskeletons to adapt assistance to the user across many tasks. A leading example is biological torque control, which estimates the user's own joint moment from onboard sensors and assists in proportion to that estimate. However, its estimators are trained on data recorded with the target device, so deploying the controller on new hardware requires collecting new data. Existing open-source efforts release hardware, software, or controllers separately, so this data collection must still be repeated on the assembled device. Here, we present an open-source knee exoskeleton, built from off-the-shelf components and widely available fabrication tools, with a biological torque controller derived entirely from simulation. A muscle-driven imitation policy reproduces squatting motions from an open biomechanics dataset, and the resulting knee moments are distilled into an estimator that uses only onboard sensors, so no training data are recorded on the device. In seven able-bodied participants, assistance reduced peak biological knee extension moment by 21.5% and peak vastus medialis activation by 26.7% during squatting, relative to squatting without the exoskeleton (p<0.05). Our results demonstrate that a biological torque controller derived from simulation can transfer to physical hardware without device-specific data collection. Because the hardware and training pipeline are released together, research groups can train and compare knee exoskeleton controllers on shared hardware without additional data collection overhead.

AI.tldr: 为免除在目标设备上重新采集训练数据，作者用开源生物力学数据集训练肌肉驱动模仿策略复现蹲起动作，把得到的膝关节力矩蒸馏成只用本体传感器的估计器，构成开源膝关节外骨骼的生物力矩控制器；7名健全参与者蹲起时峰值生物膝关节伸展力矩降低21.5%、峰值股内侧肌激活降低26.7%（相对不戴外骨骼，p<0.05）。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动控制器让下肢外骨骼能按用户状态调整助力，其中"生物力矩控制"用本体传感器估计用户自身关节力矩并按估计值助力；但这类估计器是在目标设备上录的数据上训练的，换到新硬件就必须重新采数据。现有开源工作分别发布硬件、软件或控制器，组装后仍需在整机上重复数据采集。摘要指出这一设备特定数据采集负担是待解决的问题。
AI.method: 输入是一套开源生物力学数据集中的蹲起运动。方法用肌肉驱动的模仿策略复现这些蹲起动作，再由仿真得到的膝关节力矩蒸馏出一个只用本体传感器（不依赖设备上录制的训练数据）的估计器，形成生物力矩控制器，驱动一台用现成组件和常见制造工具搭建的开源膝关节外骨骼。相对被描述的既有做法（估计器在目标设备数据上训练），本方法把训练数据来源从目标设备换成仿真；硬件与训练管线一并发布。
AI.result: 作者报告：在7名健全参与者中，助力使蹲起时的峰值生物膝关节伸展力矩降低21.5%、峰值股内侧肌激活降低26.7%，比较对象是"不戴外骨骼的蹲起"，p<0.05（相对百分比降低，非百分点）。作者还报告该仿真推导的生物力矩控制器可迁移到实体硬件且无需设备特定数据采集。摘要未给出与其他控制器基线、其他任务或仿真内数值的对比。
AI.conclusion: 对穿戴式助力控制而言，该结果提示生物力矩控制器的训练可以来自仿真与公开生物力学数据，从而减少换硬件时的设备特定数据采集，并让不同研究组在共享硬件与管线上比较控制器。证据边界：仅7名健全参与者、仅蹲起任务、仅与"不戴外骨骼"比较，摘要未报告与其他控制器的对比、其他任务/人群验证及部署细节。
AI.core_method: 用公开生物力学数据训练肌肉驱动模仿策略生成蹲起动作，把仿真得到的膝关节力矩蒸馏成仅用本体传感器的力矩估计器来驱动开源外骨骼。

key_results.finding: 作者报告基于仿真推导的生物力矩控制器可迁移到实体硬件，且无需在设备上采集特定训练数据（无量化指标）
key_results.setting: 任务：蹲起；硬件：用现成组件搭建的开源膝关节外骨骼；摘要未报告迁移的量化指标或对比条件
key_results.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrate that a biological torque controller derived from simulation can transfer to physical hardware without device-specific data collection.

limitations: 作者自述局限：摘要未报告任何作者明确陈述的局限性。
摘要未报告：与数据驱动生物力矩控制器或其他控制器基线的定量对比，也未报告仿真与实体结果之间的差距量化。

029858b8025fabb78a68ec7618d6db8725b0580c.title: Contact-based optimization for collision-free motion planning for a million robots
029858b8025fabb78a68ec7618d6db8725b0580c.summary: Multi-agent robotic systems have attracted growing interest in recent years, with applications ranging from coordinated drone shows to autonomous operations on land, in the air, and on water. At the planning level, robot motion is often modeled using double-integrator dynamics (with low-level controllers handling the physical dynamics during execution) with a minimum-energy objective subject to collision-avoidance constraints and limits on position, velocity, and acceleration. The complexity of the problem resides in the constraints, which couple the trajectories and make the optimization problem nonconvex. Existing numerical approaches typically discretize and optimize entire trajectories, which becomes expensive for large fleets. We exploit the structure of optimal trajectories by organizing optimization around contacts, at which robots reach the minimum allowed separation. We formulate a coupled algebraic system in contact variables and reconstruct trajectories analytically between contacts. Our algorithm, sequential contact insertion (SCI), starts from unconstrained trajectories, inserts contacts at separation violations, and jointly adjusts their times and states. Numerical experiments demonstrate planning for one million robots in minutes and thousands of robots in fractions of a second. On problems feasible for a fixed-grid sequential convex programming baseline, SCI achieves median speedups of several orders of magnitude at matching solution accuracy.

AI.tldr: 大规模多机器人避碰轨迹优化因约束耦合而非凸、且现有方法需离散并优化整条轨迹，规模增大后代价高；作者改为围绕"接触"（机器人达到允许最小间距处）组织优化，在接触之间解析重建轨迹，并提出顺序接触插入（SCI）算法。数值实验中可在数分钟内规划一百万机器人、在零点几秒内规划数千机器人；在固定网格序列凸规划（SCP）基线可求解的问题上，中位加速达数个数量级且解精度相当。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出：多智能体机器人系统应用日增（如协同无人机表演、陆地/空中/水面自主作业）；规划层面常用双积分器动力学（物理动力学由底层控制器在执行时处理）、最小能量目标，并受碰撞规避约束及位置、速度、加速度限制。困难在于约束耦合各条轨迹、使优化问题非凸；现有数值方法通常离散并优化整条轨迹，车队规模大时变得昂贵。
AI.method: 输入是双积分器动力学下的多机器人轨迹规划问题：最小能量目标，受碰撞规避约束与位置、速度、加速度限制（物理动力学由底层控制器在执行阶段处理）。方法不再离散整条轨迹，而是利用最优轨迹的结构，把优化组织在"接触"上——即机器人达到允许最小间距的时刻；据此把问题写成以接触变量表示的耦合代数系统，两个接触之间的轨迹用解析方式重建。算法名为顺序接触插入（SCI）：从无约束轨迹出发，在出现间距违反的位置插入接触，并联合调整这些接触的时间与状态。输出是满足避碰与状态限制的规划轨迹。
AI.result: 摘要报告的是数值实验结果，未报告真机实验。规模方面：可对数以百万计的机器人进行分钟级规划，对数千机器人耗时不足一秒（分数秒）。对比方面：在固定网格序列凸规划基线可求解的问题上，SCI 的中位加速为"数个数量级"，且解精度与基线相当。摘要给出了加速的量级表述，但未给出具体倍数数值、问题规模设定、硬件条件或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能中的大规模多机器人规划，该工作提示可以利用最优轨迹的接触结构来降低优化维度：不等间隔地解析重建轨迹、只对接触变量求解，从而把可处理的舰队规模推向百万级、把数千机器人问题压缩到亚秒级。但证据边界明确：全部结果来自摘要所述的数值实验，摘要未报告真机部署、未报告对底层控制器跟踪误差的处理，也未报告可行性或最优性的理论保证；因此不能据摘要推断实际系统上的同等表现。"中位加速数个数量级"是相对固定网格 SCP 基线、且仅在基线可求解的问题上报告的结论，属作者自述、未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 以机器人达到允许最小间距的"接触"时刻为变量构建耦合代数系统，接触之间解析重建轨迹，并从无约束轨迹出发逐次插入接触、联合调整接触时间与状态。

key_results.finding: 在数值实验中，SCI 可对数以百万计的机器人进行分钟级规划，对数千机器人可在不足一秒内完成规划。
key_results.setting: 多机器人（双积分器动力学、最小能量目标、含碰撞规避与位置/速度/加速度限制）轨迹规划的数值实验；具体硬件、轨迹长度与精度阈值摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Numerical experiments demonstrate planning for one million robots in minutes and thousands of robots in fractions of a second.

key_results.finding: 在固定网格序列凸规划（SCP）基线可求解的问题上，SCI 取得数个数量级的中位加速，同时解精度与基线相当。
key_results.setting: 基线为 fixed-grid sequential convex programming；仅在基线可行的问题子集上比较；具体倍数、问题规模与精度指标摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: On problems feasible for a fixed-grid sequential convex programming baseline, SCI achieves median speedups of several orders of magnitude at matching solution accuracy.

limitations: 摘要未报告作者自述的局限性；以下为信息缺失项：摘要仅提及数值实验，未报告任何真机/实飞实验或真实系统部署结果。
摘要未报告量化细节：未给出具体加速倍数、机器人规模与问题实例数量、硬件配置、精度度量数值与统计显著性，因此无法判断该中位加速的适用范围。
摘要未报告理论性质（如可行性、最优性或收敛性保证），也未报告与固定网格 SCP 基线之外其他方法的比较。

a8b431f2ca0df6ca80ab8e64ec1541f3e7f91a35.title: Mechanistic Interpretability for End-to-End Self-Driving
a8b431f2ca0df6ca80ab8e64ec1541f3e7f91a35.comment: Accepted to the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: this https URL
a8b431f2ca0df6ca80ab8e64ec1541f3e7f91a35.summary: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving models achieve strong planning performance but remain largely opaque, limiting observability and trust. We apply mechanistic interpretability to E2E driving by training Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) on the internal activations of a simple, single-camera end-to-end path planning model. Unsupervised clustering of SAE latents reveals interpretable structure aligned with route intent, vehicle speed, and braking behavior, recovering route intent with 98.3% accuracy without supervision. Through paired counterfactual image edits, we further show that specific SAE features are visually grounded and systematically respond to scene changes such as traffic light state and stop sign presence. Steering individual SAE latents produces predictable, monotonic changes in planner outputs including lateral displacement, curvature, and braking. Finally, we demonstrate a practical application of these representations: we build a lightweight adapter trained on SAE latents that reduces trajectory selection error by 3.44%, outperforming an equivalent adapter that omits SAE latents, confirming that the sparse representation captures useful information for interpretability. Code and visualizations are available at this https URL

7008b9c6dfff5da7368d62c121e7f0c378bb2d79.title: Interaction-Aware Sampling-Based Motion Planning for Autonomous Surface Vessels in Urban Waterways
7008b9c6dfff5da7368d62c121e7f0c378bb2d79.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
7008b9c6dfff5da7368d62c121e7f0c378bb2d79.summary: Autonomous surface vessels operating in urban waterways must coordinate with other vessels in confined spaces while complying with traffic regulations, often without knowing their intentions. We present a decentralized motion planner based on model predictive path integral control, a sampling-based model predictive control scheme. The planner jointly computes a trajectory for the ego vessel and a prediction of the trajectories of the other vessels, and therefore accounts for their interaction. Traffic regulations are encoded as discontinuous costs, which the sampling-based formulation admits without a smooth approximation. We evaluate the method in maps taken from real sections of Amsterdam's canals, in encounters between two vessels and in scenarios with four interacting vessels. Across 780 randomized runs the method reaches every goal without collisions or deadlocks, and outperforms an optimization-based planner designed for the same domain, as well as a version of the proposed planner that does not account for the interaction. We further validate the planner on two scaled vessel prototypes in an outdoor environment, where planning and localization run onboard at 10 Hz, and head-on and crossing encounters are resolved without collisions or rule violations.

AI.tldr: 面向城市水道中他船意图未知、需在受限空间遵守交通规则的协同问题，作者提出基于模型预测路径积分控制的分散式规划器，联合计算自船轨迹与他船轨迹预测，并把交通规则编码为不连续代价；780 次随机化仿真运行全部到达目标且无碰撞、无死锁，并在两艘缩比船原型上以 10 Hz 板载运行完成室外验证。
AI.motivation: 城市水道中的自主水面船必须在受限空间内与其他船只协调，同时遵守交通规则，而且往往并不知道他船的意图。摘要指出这是该工作要解决的场景性缺口。
AI.method: 输入是水道地图与船只相遇场景中的自船状态及其他船只的（意图未知的）观测。方法是一个分散式运动规划器，属于采样式模型预测控制：在采样过程中，它把自船轨迹与他船轨迹预测放在一起联合优化，因此显式考虑船间交互，输出的是自船的规划轨迹。相对基线的关键改动有两处：一是把交互（他船轨迹预测）纳入同一优化目标，二是不对交通规则做平滑近似，而是直接以不连续代价形式编码，由采样式公式直接承受。摘要未报告采样数量、预测模型形式、通信假设或计算资源等实现细节。
AI.result: 作者报告：在取自阿姆斯特丹运河真实河段地图的两船相遇与四船交互场景中，780 次随机化运行里方法每次都到达目标，无碰撞、无死锁，并优于一个面向同领域设计的优化式规划器，以及一个不考虑交互的自身变体；该优势仅以定性表述给出，摘要未报告任何量化差值。实船方面，在两艘缩比船原型上于室外环境验证，规划与定位板载以 10 Hz 运行，迎面与交叉相遇均无碰撞、无规则违反。以上均为作者报告，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型读者的意义在于：在受限、规则约束且他船意图不可知的多智能体场景中，把“他船未来轨迹的联合预测”与“不可微的规则代价”直接放进采样式模型预测控制，是一条不必依赖平滑近似即可实现交互感知规划的可行路线，并且该路线在缩比硬件上能以板载频率运行。但证据边界很明确：摘要只给出仿真中的定性优越性（无成功率差值、百分比或统计检验）、10 Hz 板载频率以及两艘缩比原型的室外相遇结果；不能据此推断全尺寸船舶、大规模船群或真实城市水道部署的表现。
AI.core_method: 在采样式模型预测控制中对自船轨迹与他船轨迹预测做联合优化，并把交通规则作为不连续代价直接评估，从而在不做平滑近似的前提下显式考虑船间交互。

key_results.finding: 在 780 次随机化运行中，方法每次都到达目标，无碰撞、无死锁，并优于面向同领域的优化式规划器以及不考虑交互的自身变体；摘要未给出量化优势幅度。
key_results.setting: 仿真；使用取自阿姆斯特丹运河真实河段的地图；两船相遇与四船交互场景；对比对象为面向同领域设计的优化式规划器和不建模交互的版本。运行时间、采样规模与统计检验摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Across 780 randomized runs the method reaches every goal without collisions or deadlocks, and outperforms an optimization-based planner designed for the same domain, as well as a version of the proposed planner that does not account for the interaction.

key_results.finding: 在两艘缩比船原型上于室外环境验证，规划与定位板载以 10 Hz 运行，迎面与交叉相遇均无碰撞、无规则违反。
key_results.setting: 室外环境；两艘缩比船原型；规划与定位板载运行；迎面与交叉相遇场景。运行次数、成功率数值、与仿真结果的对比摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: We further validate the planner on two scaled vessel prototypes in an outdoor environment, where planning and localization run onboard at 10 Hz, and head-on and crossing encounters are resolved without collisions or rule violations.

limitations: 作者在摘要中未报告任何局限性（属作者未报告，而非方法不具备相应能力）。
“优于优化式规划器与不考虑交互的版本”只有定性表述，摘要未报告成功率差值、百分比、单位或统计显著性，无法判断提升幅度（摘要未报告）。
评测范围限于两船与四船场景以及两艘缩比船原型；摘要未报告更大规模船群、全尺寸船舶、运行次数、计算资源与通信假设（摘要未报告）。

93ecefabc309e4dc1bd51193f65f3b259eade6b3.title: One Verdict Is Not Enough: Regression Testing Learned World Models and Their Test Harnesses
93ecefabc309e4dc1bd51193f65f3b259eade6b3.summary: Learned world models ship as software components whose model versions, preprocessing, and test harnesses change between releases. Work on model updates already counts per-sample regressions, or negative flips, that an accuracy check hides. Two problems remain: a test can pass under one configuration and fail under another, and a harness fault can produce erroneous scores and wrong verdicts without a crash. We present TetraState, a regression-testing protocol for paired possible/impossible video tests. Each test runs under four fixed model-native configurations; its number of correct verdicts assigns one of four outcome classes. Inconclusive tests and failed executions are reported separately alongside the verdict rate. Revisions are compared by per-test outcome transitions, and the harness is versioned as part of the system under test. On all 506 IntPhys 2 Main tests and two heterogeneous systems, Cosmos 3 Nano and V-JEPA 2, two V-JEPA 2 harness revisions move modal accuracy by only 0.2 and 2.6 points yet change 11 and 214 test labels; in the second, accuracy rises although fewer tests are judged correctly, and 43 regressions keep the modal verdict, so a modal-verdict flip check misses them. These results outline a research agenda on configuration-level regression oracles for learned components.

AI.tldr: 针对学习型世界模型在模型版本、预处理与测试工具变更时的回归测试缺口，提出 TetraState 协议：每个成对可能/不可能视频测试在四种模型原生配置下运行，按正确判定数归入四类结果。在 506 个 IntPhys 2 Main 测试上，两次 V-JEPA 2 工具修订只让众数准确率变化 0.2 与 2.6 个百分点，却分别改变 11 与 214 个测试标签。
AI.motivation: 已有的模型更新回归工作只统计逐样本负翻转（negative flips），而准确率检查会掩盖这些变化；摘要指出仍有两个问题：同一测试可能在一个配置下通过、在另一配置下失败；测试工具（harness）的故障可以在不崩溃的情况下产生错误分数与错误判定。
AI.method: 输入是成对的可能/不可能视频测试，以及待测的学习型世界模型系统（含模型版本、预处理与测试工具）。方法不改动模型本身，而改评测协议：每个测试在四种固定的模型原生配置下各运行一次，按其中正确判定的数量把该测试归入四种结果类别之一；不确定（inconclusive）测试与执行失败单独报告，并与判定率并列呈现；不同修订之间按逐测试的结果类别转移进行比较，且测试工具被当作被测系统的一部分进行版本化。输出是配置级的回归判定：哪些测试标签发生转移、哪些回归在众数判定不变时被掩盖。
AI.result: 作者报告：在全部 506 个 IntPhys 2 Main 测试与两个异构系统（Cosmos 3 Nano、V-JEPA 2）上，两次 V-JEPA 2 测试工具修订只使众数准确率变化 0.2 与 2.6 个百分点，却分别改变 11 与 214 个测试标签；第二次修订中准确率上升但被正确判定的测试更少，且有 43 个回归保持众数判定不变，因此仅检查众数判定翻转会漏掉它们。摘要未报告与其它回归测试方法的数值对比，也未报告统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对世界模型的回归评估而言，单一（众数）判定不足以保证发布安全：需要配置级的回归判定标准，并把测试工具纳入被测系统的版本管理。证据仅限摘要所述的 506 个 IntPhys 2 Main 测试与两个系统，作者将结论表述为研究议程；摘要未报告真实机器人部署、跨数据集验证或超出众数翻转检查的基线对比。
AI.core_method: 让每个成对视频测试在四种固定配置下重复运行，用正确判定数划分结果类别，并以逐测试结果转移来比较版本，同时把测试工具本身纳入版本管理。

key_results.finding: 在 506 个 IntPhys 2 Main 测试、两个异构系统（Cosmos 3 Nano、V-JEPA 2）上，两次 V-JEPA 2 测试工具修订仅使众数准确率变化 0.2 与 2.6 个百分点，却分别改变 11 与 214 个测试标签。
key_results.setting: 任务：成对可能/不可能视频测试的回归测试；基准：全部 506 个 IntPhys 2 Main 测试；系统：Cosmos 3 Nano 与 V-JEPA 2；对象：两次 V-JEPA 2 测试工具修订；对照量：众数准确率变化（0.2、2.6 points）。摘要未报告运行次数、硬件或统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: On all 506 IntPhys 2 Main tests and two heterogeneous systems, Cosmos 3 Nano and V-JEPA 2, two V-JEPA 2 harness revisions move modal accuracy by only 0.2 and 2.6 points yet change 11 and 214 test labels

key_results.finding: 第二次工具修订中准确率上升，但被正确判定的测试更少；43 个回归保持众数判定不变，因此只检查众数判定翻转会漏掉它们。
key_results.setting: 对象：第二次 V-JEPA 2 测试工具修订；指标：准确率方向、被正确判定的测试数、保持众数判定的回归数（43）；对照：仅检查众数判定翻转（modal-verdict flip check）。摘要未报告具体准确率数值或测试总数变化。
key_results.evidence_quote: in the second, accuracy rises although fewer tests are judged correctly, and 43 regressions keep the modal verdict, so a modal-verdict flip check misses them.

limitations: 作者自述性定位：结果用于"outline a research agenda"，即配置级回归判定标准尚未成熟，摘要未报告该协议的更广泛验证。
摘要未报告：除众数判定翻转检查之外的基线对比、统计显著性、运行次数与四配置的具体构成。
摘要未报告：IntPhys 2 之外的其它数据集/基准，也未报告真实机器人或部署场景下的验证（该协议面向视频世界模型测试）。

9d074de1dab472587da56669e38f7e637e12d17a.title: Agentic World Modeling for Agent Test-time Scaling without Environment Replica
9d074de1dab472587da56669e38f7e637e12d17a.summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model agents by sampling and selecting among multiple candidate trajectories, but common realizations assume that these trajectories can be executed in parallel. This assumption breaks in realistic deployments, where enterprise workspaces and cloud services are shared and persistent, costly or infeasible to replicate, and actions may introduce irreversible side effects or cross-trajectory interference. Existing generative world models avoid direct execution, but typically compress environment state into a single prompt, limiting their ability to reliably simulate transitions under partial observability. Instead, we introduce Agentic World Modeling (AWM), which reformulates next-observation prediction as a multi-turn evidence-acquisition task. For each hypothetical action, an agentic simulator adaptively queries the real environment through safe read-only interfaces, reasons over the returned evidence, and uses executable computation to construct the resulting observation without mutating shared state. Integrated with trajectory-level TTS, AWM enables parallel exploration over a single shared environment. Across $\tau$-bench, AppWorld, and OfficeBench, AWM outperforms a single-shot simulation baseline by 40.07% on average, and surpasses a trained world-model baseline by 12.36% on average. These results establish interactive, read-grounded simulation as a practical foundation for safe and scalable agentic test-time scaling in shared, non-resettable environments.

AI.tldr: 针对真实共享环境无法并行复制轨迹的问题，作者提出 Agentic World Modeling（AWM），把"下一步观测预测"改写为多轮证据获取任务：智能体模拟器通过只读接口查询真实环境并计算得到假想动作的结果观测，从而在单一共享环境上支持轨迹级 test-time scaling。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，常见的 test-time scaling 实现假设多条候选轨迹可以并行执行，但在企业工作区与云服务等共享、持久、复制代价高昂或不可行的部署中该假设失效，且动作可能带来不可逆副作用或跨轨迹干扰。既有生成式世界模型虽避免直接执行，却通常把环境状态压缩进单个提示，在部分可观测下难以可靠模拟状态转移。
AI.method: 输入是每条候选轨迹中的假想动作；机制上，AWM 不再用一次前向生成观测，而是把"下一步观测预测"重构为多轮证据获取任务：agentic simulator 针对该假想动作自适应地向真实环境发起安全的只读查询，对返回证据进行推理，并用可执行计算构造出对应的结果观测，且不修改共享状态。输出是用于轨迹级 TTS 的模拟观测序列，使多条轨迹可在同一个共享环境上并行探索。相对于摘要中提到的单次（single-shot）模拟基线与已训练的世界模型基线，变化在于从"单提示状态压缩"改为"交互式、有真实证据支撑的模拟"。
AI.result: 作者报告在 τ-bench、AppWorld 和 OfficeBench 上，AWM 平均优于单次模拟基线 40.07%，平均优于已训练世界模型基线 12.36%；摘要未给出各基准的分项数值、单位定义（相对提升或百分点）、绝对值以及统计显著性。摘要将这些结果表述为"交互式、有证据支撑的模拟可作为共享、不可重置环境中安全且可扩展的 agentic TTS 的实用基础"。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型研究而言，该工作提示：世界模型的作用可以从"一次性生成状态"转向"在真实环境中安全取证并计算转移"，从而把 TTS 的并行采样需求与非可复制、有副作用的环境约束解耦。证据边界明确：仅三个文本/办公类 agent 基准的平均对比数字，摘要未报告真实机器人实验、逐基准结果、延迟或成本，也未说明这些提升的具体度量与统计可靠性，因此不宜外推到物理具身场景。
AI.core_method: 让模拟器对每个假想动作多轮只读查询真实环境、推理返回证据并用可执行计算合成结果观测，从而在不复制、不修改共享环境的前提下并行模拟轨迹。

1ae415aadc77d7bbff27a72109b6b5e9923c8b67.title: UFMF: Radar-Guided Kinematic Priors for Real-Time 4D Occupancy Forecasting
1ae415aadc77d7bbff27a72109b6b5e9923c8b67.summary: Real-time 4D occupancy forecasting requires reliably extrapolating both ego motion and surrounding actor motion under strict latency budgets. Recent occupancy world models improve long-horizon fidelity through generative decoders and 3D volumetric modeling, yet their computational cost makes real-time deployment challenging. Light-weight BEV forecasters meet latency requirements but often blur or suppress fast-moving actors at longer horizons. We present UFMF (Ultra-Fast Multi-modal Forecaster), a real-time forecaster that keeps an attention-free diagonal state-space temporal core while injecting targeted kinematic and geometric structure where lightweight models typically fail. A radar-guided velocity-aware dynamic prior (VADP) decomposes future displacement into a linear extrapolation plus a learned horizon-dependent residual. The resulting per-cell flow fields transport a compact dynamic latent subspace during rollout. Two auxiliary training constraints complement this branch: world-frame dynamic supervision enforces inter-horizon trajectory coherence, and class-conditioned vertical-profile supervision regularizes BEV-to-3D lifting. UFMF operates at 122 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and reaches 0.45 fast-displacement mIoU on nuScenes, outperforming recent occupancy world models at a fraction of their computational cost.

AI.tldr: UFMF 面向实时 4D 占据预测：在轻量 BEV 预测器上保留无注意力的对角状态空间时序核心，并注入雷达引导的速度感知动态先验，在 nuScenes 上达到 0.45 fast-displacement mIoU，单张 RTX 4090 上 122 FPS。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出：占据世界模型通过生成式解码器和 3D 体素建模提升了长时程保真度，但计算代价使实时部署困难；轻量 BEV 预测器满足时延要求，却在更长时程上模糊或抑制快速运动目标。因此需要在严格时延预算下兼顾长时程动态目标的预测质量。
AI.method: 输入为多模态传感器流（摘要提到雷达引导与紧凑动态潜子空间，并涉及 BEV 表征），输出为未来 4D 占据。机制上，模型保留无注意力的对角状态空间时序核心以控制时延，并加入雷达引导的速度感知动态先验（VADP）：把未来位移分解为线性外推加一个随预测时程变化的学习残差；由此得到的逐单元流场在 rollout 过程中搬运紧凑的动态潜子空间。相对基线的改动是在轻量模型通常失效处注入运动学与几何结构，并辅以两项训练约束：世界坐标系动态监督以约束跨时程轨迹一致性，类别条件化的垂直剖面监督以正则化 BEV 到 3D 的抬升。摘要未报告网络规模、编解码细节或训练数据量。
AI.result: 作者报告 UFMF 在单张 RTX 4090 上以 122 FPS 运行，并在 nuScenes 上取得 0.45 fast-displacement mIoU，称其以远低于近期占据世界模型的计算代价超越这些模型；摘要未给出对比模型的具体数值、时延或精度明细。
AI.conclusion: 若如摘要所述，该工作说明在 4D 占据预测中，用显式的运动学先验（线性外推＋时程相关残差）与几何监督来弥补轻量时序核心的不足，可能在保持实时速度的同时改善快速运动目标的预测。证据限于 nuScenes 上的两项报告值（122 FPS、0.45 fast-displacement mIoU）与作者对超越占据世界模型的表述，缺乏多基准验证、真实机器人部署与误差分解，故不能推断其在其他数据集或实车闭环中的表现。
AI.core_method: 在无注意力的对角状态空间时序核心上，用雷达引导的速度感知先验把未来位移拆成线性外推＋时程相关残差，生成逐单元流场来搬运动态潜子空间完成占据 rollout。

key_results.finding: 单张 RTX 4090 上达到 122 FPS 的实时推理速度。
key_results.setting: 任务：实时 4D 占据预测；硬件：单张 RTX 4090；基线对比：摘要仅称计算代价远低于近期占据世界模型，未报告对比模型的具体数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: UFMF operates at 122 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and reaches 0.45 fast-displacement mIoU on nuScenes, outperforming recent occupancy world models at a fraction of their computational cost.

key_results.finding: 在 nuScenes 上取得 0.45 fast-displacement mIoU，作者称其以远低于近期占据世界模型的计算代价实现超越。
key_results.setting: 数据集/基准：nuScenes；指标：fast-displacement mIoU；基线：近期占据世界模型（摘要未给出其数值）。
key_results.evidence_quote: UFMF operates at 122 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and reaches 0.45 fast-displacement mIoU on nuScenes, outperforming recent occupancy world models at a fraction of their computational cost.

limitations: 摘要仅报告 nuScenes 上的结果，未报告其他数据集、真实机器人部署或闭环验证（摘要未报告）。
未报告与占据世界模型对比时的具体数值、时延明细，也未给出两项辅助监督约束的消融结果（摘要未报告）。
作者未在摘要中陈述方法局限性；摘要指出轻量 BEV 预测器在长时程上会模糊或抑制快速运动目标，这是所针对的既有方法问题而非本文自报缺陷。

1bf9ae41700e7d217b62c4de81830bd5eca65731.title: CuPIQP: A Batched and Differentiable QP Solver on GPUs for Robot Learning and Control
1bf9ae41700e7d217b62c4de81830bd5eca65731.summary: Quadratic programs (QPs) are fundamental building blocks of many robotic tasks such as inverse kinematics, whole-body control, and model predictive control. Extending these methods to large-scale robot learning and control requires solving many QPs concurrently and, for end-to-end learning, differentiating through their solutions. Efficient batched optimization is therefore essential to bringing established model-based methods into GPU-based robotics pipelines. We present \textsc{cuPIQP}, a batched and differentiable QP solver on GPUs based on a proximal interior-point method, with unified support for dense, sparse, and multistage problems. The solver exploits parallelism across independent QPs and their internal structure while preserving per-problem numerical updates and termination decisions. Benchmarks with up to 16384 QPs per batch demonstrate solve-time speedups of up to $18.8\times$ over \textsc{Moreau} and $4.26\times$ over eight-core \textsc{PIQP}. In an end-to-end learning task, \textsc{cuPIQP} accelerates training by $4.6\times$ over \textsc{QPAX} and $7.8\times$ over \textsc{Moreau}. By reducing the computational cost, \textsc{cuPIQP} provides efficient, reusable infrastructure for integrating model-based optimization into large-scale robot learning and control.

AI.tldr: 针对机器人大规模学习与控制中需要同时求解大量 QP 并对其解求导的问题，作者提出 GPU 上的批处理可微 QP 求解器 cuPIQP，基于近端内点法，支持稠密、稀疏与多阶段问题。摘要报告：每批最多 16384 个 QP 时求解时间最高加速 18.8×（对比 Moreau）与 4.26×（对比八核 PIQP），端到端学习训练加速 4.6×（对比 QPAX）与 7.8×（对比 Moreau）。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出 QP 是逆运动学、全身控制和模型预测控制等机器人任务的基本构件，而把这些方法扩展到大规模机器人学习与控制需要并发求解大量 QP，并在端到端学习时对解进行微分；因此高效批处理优化是把既有基于模型的方法接入 GPU 机器人流水线的必要环节。
AI.method: 输入是一批待求解的 QP（摘要称统一支持稠密、稀疏与多阶段三类问题）。方法基于近端内点法（proximal interior-point method），在不同 QP 之间及其内部结构上挖掘并行性，同时保留每个问题各自的数值更新与终止判断；由于可微，它既能输出批量 QP 解，也能为端到端学习提供通过解的反向传播。相对摘要中提到的基线（Moreau、八核 PIQP、QPAX），变化在于把 QP 求解做成 GPU 上的批量、可微原语，而非单问题 CPU 求解或非可微求解。
AI.result: 作者报告：在每批最多 16384 个 QP 的基准测试中，求解时间相对 Moreau 最高加速 18.8×，相对八核 PIQP 加速 4.26×；在一个端到端学习任务中，相对 QPAX 训练加速 4.6×，相对 Moreau 加速 7.8×。摘要未报告精度、最优性间隙、内存占用、GPU 型号等条件，也未报告真机实验。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于提供可复用的基础设施：把基于模型的优化（如 IK、全身控制、MPC 所需的 QP）以批量、可微形式放入 GPU 机器人学习流水线，降低计算成本。证据边界：以上均为摘要中的作者自述加速结果，未报告求解精度/最优性、硬件与批大小之外的实验条件，也未提及真机验证，因此不能据此推断实机部署效果或与基线的解质量一致性。
AI.core_method: 用近端内点法在 GPU 上并行求解一整批 QP，并保留每个问题独立的数值更新与终止判断，使求解可批处理且可微。

key_results.finding: 在每批最多 16384 个 QP 的基准测试中，求解时间相对 Moreau 最高加速 18.8×，相对八核 PIQP 加速 4.26×。
key_results.setting: 任务：批量 QP 求解基准；批大小：每批最多 16384 个 QP；基线：Moreau、八核 PIQP；硬件与精度条件：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Benchmarks with up to 16384 QPs per batch demonstrate solve-time speedups of up to $18.8\times$ over \textsc{Moreau} and $4.26\times$ over eight-core \textsc{PIQP}.

key_results.finding: 在一个端到端学习任务中，cuPIQP 使训练相对 QPAX 加速 4.6×，相对 Moreau 加速 7.8×。
key_results.setting: 任务：端到端学习（摘要未给出具体任务、数据集或模型细节）；基线：QPAX、Moreau；是否真机：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: In an end-to-end learning task, \textsc{cuPIQP} accelerates training by $4.6\times$ over \textsc{QPAX} and $7.8\times$ over \textsc{Moreau}.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中报告任何局限或失败情形（作者自述限制：摘要未报告）。
摘要未报告求解精度、最优性间隙或与基线的解质量一致性，因此加速是否以精度为代价无法判断（摘要未报告）。
摘要未报告 GPU 型号、显存占用、测试任务的具体机器人场景与真机验证（摘要未报告）。

054aebd5180db47bdfa9c1ecb04c41c023b41e21.title: A complete analytical characterization of optimal collision-free motion for two robots
054aebd5180db47bdfa9c1ecb04c41c023b41e21.summary: Collision-free motion planning for multi-agent robotic systems remains an active research area because of the complexity of coordinating robot trajectories, with applications ranging from coordinated drone shows to autonomous operations on land, in the air, and on water. Importantly, the analytical difficulty of nonconvex collision-avoidance constraints has so far driven the development of exclusively numerical methods. We derive a complete analytical characterization of the optimal trajectories for two robots that start and end at rest, under double-integrator dynamics and a squared-acceleration objective. We prove that these trajectories belong to eight distinct contact families and determine which family applies for each configuration of initial and final positions. We analyze the geometrical properties of the optimal trajectories, provide a numerical algorithm for computing them, and discuss how these insights may improve the performance of existing numerical trajectory optimizers.

AI.tldr: 针对多机器人无碰撞运动规划长期只能依赖数值方法的问题，作者对两个机器人（起止静止、双积分动力学、平方加速度目标）推导了最优轨迹的完整解析刻画，证明最优解属于八类接触族并给出各族的适用条件。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，多智能体系统的无碰撞运动规划仍然是活跃研究领域，其困难在于协调多机器人轨迹；关键在于非凸避碰约束的解析难度，导致迄今发展出的方法“exclusively numerical”（完全依赖数值方法）。作者因此转向两机器人这一可解析的基本情形。
AI.method: 输入是两个机器人各自的初始与终止位置（均起止静止），在双积分动力学与平方加速度代价下求解无碰撞最优轨迹。方法上的改变是不再做纯数值搜索，而是对该问题给出完整解析刻画：证明最优轨迹只可能属于八种不同的“接触族”（contact families），并判定每一组初始/终止位置配置对应哪一族；随后分析最优轨迹的几何性质，并给出一个用于计算它们的数值算法。输出是族分类、几何性质与计算算法，以及这些结论如何用于改进现有数值轨迹优化器。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量结果、基准、指标数值或与基线的比较；作者仅在表述中指出可用这些结论“improve the performance of existing numerical trajectory optimizers”，但未给出改进幅度或实验条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的意义在于把两机器人无碰撞最优运动从“只能数值求解”推进到具有完整代数/几何分类的解析刻画，理论上为理解非凸避碰约束的解结构提供了基础。但证据仅限于摘要层面的理论声明：无实机或仿真实验、无性能数值、无与现有优化器的对比，因此其加速或改进效果尚未被报告。
AI.core_method: 在双积分动力学与平方加速度代价下解析求解两机器人避碰最优控制，将最优轨迹归类为八种接触族并给出位置配置到族的判定规则。
limitations: 摘要未报告任何定量结果（无指标、数值、基准或与数值优化基线的对比）。
摘要未报告实机或仿真实验验证，也未说明所给数值算法的计算效率。
作者仅在摘要中提出这些结论“可能”改进现有数值轨迹优化器的性能，未给出实现或效果证据；八族分类是否覆盖非双积分动力学、多于两个机器人的情形，摘要未报告。

9254f8ead78d334137daaf40ea0a5b807efb051c.title: Higher-Order Kinematic Derivatives for Aspect-Preserving Real-Time Numerical Inverse Kinematics
9254f8ead78d334137daaf40ea0a5b807efb051c.summary: This paper leverages the higher-order kinematic derivatives of serial robots to achieve efficient, aspect-preserving real-time inverse kinematics. First, a family of higher-order solvers is derived, with a necessary orientation-error correction map, yielding the QuIK4 and QuIK5 methods with fourth- and fifth-order convergence. Second, an aspect-preserving step limiter extrapolates the Jacobian determinant along the step to predict and avoid singularities, shortening steps only when they head toward a singularity rather than when the current iterate is ill-conditioned. Third, a Hermite-interpolation certifier verifies the aspect of each answer, and a certified restart algorithm recovers failures from proven same-aspect seeds. The proposed methods are shown to outperform prior methods, reducing failures by up to four orders of magnitude and nearly eliminating aspect switching at tracking-level errors. A C++ library is released with ROS 2 integration.

AI.tldr: 针对串联机器人实时数值逆运动学（IK）失败率高、易发生 aspect switching 的问题，作者用高阶运动学导数推导出四阶/五阶求解器，并加入保 aspect 的步长限制器与 Hermite 插值认证器＋认证重启。作者报告失败数最多降低四个数量级，并在 tracking-level errors 下几乎消除 aspect switching。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出既有的数值 IK 在实时使用中会出现求解失败，并存在“歧解切换”（aspect switching）问题；作者认为当前迭代点病态并不能代表该步会走向奇异，因此需要能沿步长预测奇异性、并保证解所在 aspect 不被改变的方法。
AI.method: 输入是串联机器人的运动学模型与目标位姿；方法利用其高阶运动学导数：先推导出一族高阶求解器，并引入必要的姿态误差修正映射，得到四阶收敛的 QuIK4 与五阶收敛的 QuIK5。其次设计保 aspect 的步长限制器，沿步长外推 Jacobian 行列式来预测并回避奇异，只有在该步确实朝奇异方向前进时才缩短步长，而不是在当前迭代点病态时就缩短。最后用 Hermite 插值认证器校验每个解的 aspect，并用认证重启算法从已证明同 aspect 的种子恢复失败。输出是满足 aspect 约束的实时 IK 解，并附带提供 ROS 2 集成的 C++ 库。
AI.result: 作者称所提方法优于先前方法：失败数最多降低四个数量级，并在 tracking-level errors 下几乎消除 aspect switching；求解器收敛阶为四阶（QuIK4）与五阶（QuIK5）。摘要未报告具体基准名称、机器人平台、真机或仿真条件、绝对数值与统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：把 IK 的求解质量从“迭代点局部条件”转向“步长方向的奇异性预测”与“解所属分支（aspect）的认证”，并以 C++/ROS 2 形式面向实时部署。证据仅限于摘要的作者自述，未见独立验证，也未见定量验证是在真机还是仿真中完成。
AI.core_method: 用串联机器人的高阶运动学导数构造四阶/五阶 IK 迭代，并沿步长外推 Jacobian 行列式以避免奇异、用插值认证器与重启保证解所在的 aspect 不变。

07f4c9824171f7712815929fb8901a4d0383f747.title: FlapSim: A Composable MuJoCo Simulation Platform and Reduced-Order Aerodynamic Model Hierarchy for Flapping-Wing Robotics
07f4c9824171f7712815929fb8901a4d0383f747.summary: Flapping-wing simulation must reconcile high-frequency wingbeat aerodynamics with the slower dynamics relevant to flight control and reinforcement learning. We present FlapSim, a modular open-source MuJoCo simulation platform that combines robot descriptions, wing geometry, and composable aerodynamic models in a deterministic simulation pipeline. Across $48$ held-out scenarios spanning frequency, gimbal, wind, frequency-step, gust, and cross-robot flat-plate regimes, we compare five reduced-order configurations operating at $1\,\text{ms}$ with a $50\,\mu\text{s}$ quasi-steady blade-element reference. The built-in hover cycle-averaged baseline achieves a $67.51\times$ CPU speedup but only $0.6593$ mean wrench fidelity. Combining multirate $21$-substep clock synchronization, three-dimensional linear/quadratic inflow and gust coupling, analytical blade-element geometry scaling, and phase-locked $1f\text{--}6f$ harmonics raises mean fidelity to $0.9646$ at a $65.19\times$ speedup in a five-block model. A streamlined four-block model without explicit step-transient lag states achieves $0.9662$ fidelity at a $67.98\times$ speedup. Controlled ablations show that stroke harmonics are particularly important during frequency transitions, improving held-out frequency-step fidelity by $+0.3176$. Transfer-function analysis explains this effect: fixed-window cycle averaging retains harmonic contributions when the wingbeat frequency changes, so within-cycle reconstruction also improves the filtered wrench. Once phase alignment and harmonic synthesis are included, explicit transient lag states provide no additional benefit in this benchmark. These results characterize the accuracy--computation tradeoff of the aerodynamic hierarchy and identify timing, inflow, geometry, and harmonic representation as central considerations for reduced-order flapping-wing simulation.

AI.tldr: FlapSim 是一个模块化开源的 MuJoCo 扑翼仿真平台，把机器人描述、翼几何与可组合气动模型接入确定性流水线。在 48 个留出场景中，五块模型把平均 wrench 保真度从内置悬停周期平均基线的 0.6593 提升到 0.9646（65.19× 加速），四块精简模型达到 0.9662（67.98× 加速）。
AI.motivation: 扑翼仿真需要同时处理高频翅拍气动与飞行控制、强化学习所关注的较慢动力学，二者时间尺度不一致。摘要指出需要在保真度与计算量之间做权衡，并刻画降阶气动模型层级的精度—算力折衷。
AI.method: 输入是机器人描述、翼几何与可组合的气动模型块；方法在 MuJoCo 中把它们组织成确定性仿真流水线，并改变降阶气动表示本身。具体改动包括：多速率 21 子步时钟同步、三维线性/二次入流与阵风耦合、解析叶元几何缩放、相位锁定的 1f–6f 谐波合成；输出是以 1 ms 步长计算的 wrench，并与 50 μs 的准定常叶元参考对比。作者比较了五种降阶配置；相对基线（内置悬停周期平均模型）的关键变化是加入相位对齐与谐波重建，同时报告显式瞬态滞后状态在此基准下不再带来额外收益。
AI.result: 评测覆盖 48 个留出场景（频率、云台、风、频率阶跃、阵风、跨机器人平板翼等区间），全部为与 50 μs 准定常叶元参考的仿真对比，摘要未报告真机实验。内置悬停周期平均基线为 67.51× CPU 加速、平均 wrench 保真度 0.6593。五块模型达到 0.9646 保真度、65.19× 加速；四块精简模型（无显式阶跃瞬态滞后状态）达到 0.9662 保真度、67.98× 加速。受控消融显示，行程谐波在频率过渡时尤其重要，使留出频率阶跃场景保真度提高 +0.3176（按摘要表述为保真度绝对提升，非百分比改进）。传递函数分析的解释是：固定窗口周期平均在翅拍频率变化时仍保留谐波贡献，因此周期内重建也改善滤波后的 wrench。作者据此报告，一旦纳入相位对齐与谐波合成，显式瞬态滞后状态在该基准中不提供额外收益。以上均为作者自报结果，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与仿真研究而言，这篇工作给出的是一个可组合的扑翼仿真基座与一套降阶气动层级：它把保真度与计算量的权衡显式量化（基线 0.6593 保真度 / 67.51× 加速，最好报告配置 0.9662 保真度 / 67.98× 加速），并指出时序同步、入流耦合、几何缩放与谐波表示是降阶扑翼仿真的关键因素。证据边界是：摘要只报告了与准定常叶元参考的仿真对比，没有真机验证、没有统计显著性，因此不能推断这些模型在真实飞行控制或强化学习任务中的策略性能。
AI.core_method: 在 MuJoCo 确定性流水线中把机器人描述、翼几何与可组合气动模块组合起来，用多速率时钟同步、三维入流/阵风耦合、解析叶元几何缩放和相位锁定谐波合成，在 1 ms 步长输出 wrench。

key_results.finding: 内置悬停周期平均基线获得 67.51× CPU 加速，但平均 wrench 保真度仅 0.6593。
key_results.setting: 48 个留出场景，降阶模型以 1 ms 运行，对照 50 μs 准定常叶元参考；仿真对比，摘要未报告真机条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: The built-in hover cycle-averaged baseline achieves a $67.51\times$ CPU speedup but only $0.6593$ mean wrench fidelity.

key_results.finding: 五块模型把平均保真度提升到 0.9646，加速比为 65.19×。
key_results.setting: 同一 48 场景留出基准，1 ms 降阶配置对比 50 μs 准定常叶元参考；摘要未报告真机与统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: Combining multirate $21$-substep clock synchronization, three-dimensional linear/quadratic inflow and gust coupling, analytical blade-element geometry scaling, and phase-locked $1f\text{--}6f$ harmonics raises mean fidelity to $0.9646$ at a $65.19\times$ speedup in a five-block model.

key_results.finding: 去掉显式阶跃瞬态滞后状态的四块精简模型达到 0.9662 保真度，加速比 67.98×。
key_results.setting: 同一留出场景基准与 1 ms / 50 μs 设置；摘要未报告消融规模、重复次数或显著性检验。
key_results.evidence_quote: A streamlined four-block model without explicit step-transient lag states achieves $0.9662$ fidelity at a $67.98\times$ speedup.

limitations: 作者报告的范围限定：显式瞬态滞后状态带来的额外收益，仅在"已纳入相位对齐与谐波合成"的这一基准内被判定为无收益，摘要未报告该结论在其他工况或真机上的适用性。

a42bf7e937b25852ca86f19f0682e31dbba86880.title: OpenVIO: A Versatile Open-Source Visual-Inertial Odometry System
a42bf7e937b25852ca86f19f0682e31dbba86880.summary: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) is a fundamental topic in robotics research. Beyond research, VIO has been adopted in a wide range of products. In this manuscript, we present OpenVIO, an open-source VIO system for research and practical applications. It is released under the MIT license. OpenVIO supports pinhole and fisheye cameras and extends this support to stitched 360° images. We describe each part of the system together with its design considerations. We also report benchmark results with other open-source VIO systems on public datasets. OpenVIO is available as open source at this https URL .

AI.tldr: OpenVIO 是一个 MIT 许可的开源视觉惯性里程计系统，支持针孔、鱼眼以及拼接的 360° 图像；作者称在公开数据集上与其他开源 VIO 系统进行了基准对比，但摘要未给出任何数值结果。

c86271cf4e90d8fdc642922c5ba17ebb11fb0747.title: FlowMoDE: Coarse-to-fine Flow Matching for Detail-aware Sim-to-Real Monocular Depth Estimation
c86271cf4e90d8fdc642922c5ba17ebb11fb0747.summary: Monocular depth estimation is a fundamental capability for 3D spatial perception in robotic and intelligent systems. While data-driven discriminative methods have achieved compelling performance for monocular depth estimation, generative approaches can reconstruct fine structural details with stronger generalization. However, most existing generative diffusion models suffer from low inference efficiency caused by multi-step sampling, whereas single-step diffusion models struggle to recover high-fidelity depth maps. To mitigate these drawbacks, this paper presents FlowMoDE, a coarse-to-fine flow-matching-based framework for efficient, structure-aware monocular depth estimation supporting sim-to-real and cross-scene generalization. The core architecture first conducts coarse-level decoding conditioned on diffused features extracted from a pre-trained semantic encoder, and subsequently restores fine-grained structural patterns via expanded decoding layers. Trained exclusively on a single synthetic indoor dataset, our proposed method outperforms prior methods across five real-world indoor and outdoor datasets, yielding an average 14.1% reduction in relative error against state-of-the-art works as well as 9.9\% reduction in chamfer distance for point cloud reconstruction. We further validate the generalization capability of FlowMoDE on realistic robotic scenes, with qualitative comparisons against state-of-the-art methods. The project page is this https URL

AI.tldr: FlowMoDE 用由粗到细的流匹配框架做单目深度估计：解码先恢复粗略结构、再细化细节，只在单个合成室内数据集上训练，却在五个真实室内外数据集上超过既有方法，平均相对误差降低 14.1%。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计是机器人与智能系统 3D 空间感知的基础能力。判别式方法性能好但生成式方法更能重建细结构细节、泛化更强；然而多数生成式扩散模型因多步采样推理效率低，而单步扩散模型又难以恢复高保真深度图。作者要在效率与细节保真之间取得平衡，并支持 sim-to-real 与跨场景泛化。
AI.method: 输入是单张图像，经预训练语义编码器提取特征并做扩散（加噪）处理；框架先用这些扩散特征做粗粒度解码，得到粗略深度结构，再通过扩展的解码层恢复细粒度结构模式。相对既有生成式方法的改变在于：用流匹配替代多步扩散采样，并把解码拆成"粗到细"两段，从而在较少采样下保留结构细节。输出是高保真的深度图（并可用于点云重建）。仅在单个合成室内数据集上训练，目标是直接迁移到真实室内外场景。
AI.result: 作者报告：仅用单个合成室内数据集训练，在五个真实室内与室外数据集上优于先前方法，相对误差平均降低 14.1%（相对百分比改进），点云重建的 chamfer distance 降低 9.9%（相对百分比改进），对比对象为已有 state-of-the-art 工作。此外在真实机器人场景上做定性比较以验证泛化能力。摘要未报告具体数据集名称、绝对误差数值、推理时延或运行硬件。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作给出一种"合成数据训练、真实场景零样本部署"的单目深度感知路径：用流匹配的单步/少步生成换取推理效率，用粗到细解码换取结构细节。证据边界是：真实机器人场景只有定性比较，效率优势只有动机陈述而无摘要中的时延数字，跨域结论基于作者自报的五个数据集平均指标，未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 先用预训练语义编码器的扩散特征做粗粒度解码得到整体结构，再用扩展解码层细化细节，并以流匹配替代多步扩散采样。

06434c1a07b2decbaae09561f5e94d2bdbc9253d.title: MotorSense: A Video-EMG Dataset of Motoric Representations for Action Understanding
06434c1a07b2decbaae09561f5e94d2bdbc9253d.comment: NeurIPS 2026. 27 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Project page: this https URL
06434c1a07b2decbaae09561f5e94d2bdbc9253d.summary: Computer vision models learn hand action only from its visual consequences, without access to the underlying embodied motor signals. We address this absence with MotorSense, the first large-scale paired egocentric video and surface electromyography (EMG) dataset. MotorSense pairs bimanual EMG bands with egocentric video and yields synchronized video, bimanual EMG and IMU, and audio across 100 hours of unscripted manipulation. EMG offers a powerful scalable alternative to manual annotation: it captures finger movement, hand configuration, and the forces exerted between hand and environment as a dense signal free of occlusion and labeler bias, whereas manual annotation is costly, subjective, and unreliable under occlusion. We use MotorSense to learn sensorimotor alignment, producing an organization of action that is shared across the visual and motoric spaces, through cross-modal pre-training between video and EMG. The resultant vision models are then transferred to downstream tasks that benefit from sensorimotor alignment: in this case, action recognition, 3D hand reconstruction, and 3D contact reconstruction. We further demonstrate a generative application in which EMG motor signals are used to condition a video diffusion model, yielding videos of fine-grained hand manipulation. Across four action-centric computer vision tasks and eight popular video datasets, we demonstrate that sensorimotor alignment provides a stronger foundation for visual representation learning than conventional self-supervised learning methods over video, outperforming every baseline across all tasks and datasets evaluated.

AI.tldr: 视觉模型只能从动作的视觉结果学习手部动作，缺少具身运动信号。作者构建 MotorSense——首个大规模第一视角视频与表面肌电（EMG）配对数据集（100 小时），并通过视频—EMG 跨模态预训练学习“感觉运动对齐”，迁移到动作识别、3D 手部重建与 3D 接触重建，并用于条件化视频扩散生成；作者称在四项任务、八个视频数据集上均优于所有基线。

59e0d5e211c819a9e81ac39c269d9bbdf55a86d4.title: Chance-Constrained Inspection Viewpoint Sequencing for On-Orbit Servicing via Safe Reinforcement Learning
59e0d5e211c819a9e81ac39c269d9bbdf55a86d4.summary: Autonomous inspection of a target spacecraft is typically the initial step in on-orbit servicing. Planning close-proximity observation viewpoints involves a complex combinatorial problem constrained by coverage, fuel, and safety considerations. This paper models the viewpoint selection as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and applies Proximal Policy Optimization with Lagrangian relaxation to solve it. The system combines a high-level planner, which sequences camera viewpoints on an observation sphere around the target, with a low-level model that assesses each transfer using the Clohessy--Wiltshire (CW) equations for relative motion. The deterministic constraints on single-impulse reachability and $\Delta v$ cap are enforced directly on the action set. Safety margins are affected by navigation and manoeuvre errors, making the actual clearance stochastic. To address this, a chance constraint on the realised trajectory is implemented, with a Lagrangian multiplier governed by PID control to adapt the penalty during training. The approach is tested on a Galileo-class navigation satellite in medium Earth orbit, modelled as a point cloud where visibility from each viewpoint considers field-of-view and line-of-sight occlusion. Across various risk budgets, the trained policy maintains the keep-out violation rate within the specified limit, achieving coverage close to its maximum and staying within the mission $\Delta v$ budget. Compared to the usual practice of applying a fixed margin to the keep-out radius and planning deterministically, the chance-constrained policy attains less than half the violation rate at comparable coverage. This makes the collision risk an explicit design parameter, eliminating the need for re-tuning per case. The learned policy selects a viewpoint without the repeated Monte Carlo risk estimates required by a greedy, chance-constrained planner at every decision point.

AI.tldr: 将航天器近距离巡检的视点排序建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），用带拉格朗日松弛的 PPO 求解，并把"实际轨迹越界"写成机会约束，由 PID 控制的拉格朗日乘子调节惩罚。在 Galileo 类中地球轨道导航卫星的点云模型上，作者报告越界违规率被保持在给定风险预算内，且与固定安全裕度的确定性规划相比，在覆盖率相当时违规率不到其一半。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，在轨服务的近距离观测视点规划是一个受覆盖、燃料和安全多重约束的组合问题；由于导航与机动误差，实际安全间距是随机的，而通常做法是对禁飞半径施加固定裕度并做确定性规划，需要按情形反复调参。
AI.method: 输入是对目标航天器的观测需求与相对运动条件：高层规划器在目标周围的"观测球"上对相机视点排序，底层模型用 Clohessy–Wiltshire (CW) 相对运动方程评估每一次转移；单脉冲可达性与 Δv 上限这两类确定性约束直接施加在动作集上。相对基线做法的改变在于，把真实轨迹的安全间距视为随机量并加入机会约束，并在训练中用 PID 控制的拉格朗日乘子自适应调整该项惩罚，从而输出在每个决策点直接给出下一视点的策略。可见性判定基于把目标建模为点云并考虑视场与视线遮挡。
AI.result: 作者在一个 Galileo 类中地球轨道导航卫星的点云模型上、跨多个风险预算进行测试并报告结果，但未给出具体的覆盖率、Δv 或违规率的数值。摘要中的定量比较是相对的：相比固定禁飞半径裕度加确定性规划的常规做法，机会约束策略在覆盖率相当时违规率不到一半。此外作者称所学策略无需像贪心式机会约束规划器那样在每个决策点重复做蒙特卡洛风险估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把碰撞风险变为可显式设定的设计参数，免去逐案例重新调参，为受覆盖/燃料/安全约束的近距离服务任务提供了一种学习式视点排序思路。证据边界：结果仅在摘要所述的仿真设定（Galileo 类 MEO 卫星、点云模型）中给出，且摘要未报告具体数值、真实在轨验证或统计显著性，所有结论均为作者自述、未独立核实。
AI.core_method: 用 CMDP 表述视点排序，以拉格朗日 PPO 优化，并把由 PID 调节乘子的机会约束加在真实轨迹的安全间距上。

key_results.finding: 跨不同风险预算，训练出的策略把禁飞违规率保持在指定上限之内，同时覆盖率接近最大值并处于任务 Δv 预算之内（摘要未给出具体数值）。
key_results.setting: Galileo 类中地球轨道导航卫星，建模为点云，可见性考虑视场与视线遮挡；多个风险预算下的仿真测试；摘要未报告基线数值与样本量。
key_results.evidence_quote: Across various risk budgets, the trained policy maintains the keep-out violation rate within the specified limit, achieving coverage close to its maximum and staying within the mission $\Delta v$ budget.

key_results.finding: 与对禁飞半径施加固定裕度并做确定性规划的常规做法相比，机会约束策略在覆盖率相当的情况下违规率不到一半。
key_results.setting: 对比基线为固定禁飞半径裕度的确定性规划；任务为 Galileo 类 MEO 导航卫星的近距离视点巡检；摘要未报告绝对违规率数值与实验次数。
key_results.evidence_quote: Compared to the usual practice of applying a fixed margin to the keep-out radius and planning deterministically, the chance-constrained policy attains less than half the violation rate at comparable coverage.

key_results.finding: 所学策略在每个决策点直接选择视点，不需要贪心式机会约束规划器所需的重复蒙特卡洛风险估计（摘要未给出计算量数值）。
key_results.setting: 与贪心、机会约束规划器对比；摘要未报告具体计算开销或时延数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: The learned policy selects a viewpoint without the repeated Monte Carlo risk estimates required by a greedy, chance-constrained planner at every decision point.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何真实航天器或在轨实验结果，验证仅基于 Galileo 类 MEO 卫星的点云模型仿真，泛化到真实任务未经证实。
摘要未报告覆盖率、Δv、违规率的具体数值，也未说明基线方法与风险预算的设置细节，因此"不到一半"的改进无法进一步量化。

56f7db530a22ee4cdf34bc01aee25c56af90fbf1.title: EgoHSI3R: Online 4D Hand-Scene Interaction Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
56f7db530a22ee4cdf34bc01aee25c56af90fbf1.summary: Egocentric videos offer an abundant source of hand-scene interactions for embodied learning, which requires recovering hands, camera, and scene consistently in a shared 3D world. Existing methods focus on either camera-frame hands or world-space hand trajectories, without jointly recovering the scene pointmaps or interaction information. Building a complete reconstruction from such specialized predictions therefore typically requires per-sequence optimization. We propose EgoHSI3R, a unified feed-forward framework for online 4D hand-scene interaction reconstruction from egocentric monocular video. To jointly recover these components, it maintains a recurrent scene representation that accumulates geometric evidence over time and provides a shared world space and scale. We introduce hand-centric prompts that fuse pretrained hand priors and local scene context, while MANO vertex queries attend to scene features to predict dense per-vertex contact. These designs enable a single network to jointly estimate camera motion, dense scene geometry, world-space bilateral MANO hands, and per-vertex hand contact. Despite operating causally, EgoHSI3R achieves the lowest world-space hand joint error on ARCTIC among the evaluated methods, while offering faster inference than existing world-space hand reconstruction pipelines and competitive camera and scene reconstruction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 针对第一视角单目视频中手、相机与场景难以在统一3D世界一致恢复的问题，EgoHSI3R以循环场景表示和手部先验提示，前馈在线联合输出相机运动、稠密场景几何、世界空间双侧MANO手与逐顶点接触。作者报告其在ARCTIC上取得所评估方法中最低的世界空间手部关节误差，推理快于现有世界空间手部重建流程，相机与场景精度有竞争力，但摘要未给出数值。
AI.motivation: 第一视角视频蕴含大量手-场景交互，可用于具身学习，但需要把双手、相机和场景一致地恢复到共享3D世界。现有方法只关注相机坐标系下的手或世界空间手部轨迹，未联合恢复场景点图或交互信息；要从这类专门预测得到完整重建，通常还需逐序列优化。
AI.method: 输入是第一视角单目视频。方法维护一个随时间累积几何证据的循环场景表示，为所有分量提供共享世界空间与尺度；引入手部中心提示，融合预训练手部先验与局部场景上下文；再用MANO顶点查询关注场景特征，预测稠密的逐顶点手部接触。相比摘要所述的分别预测或逐序列优化基线，它改为一个前馈网络、因果在线地联合估计相机运动、稠密场景几何、世界空间双侧MANO手和逐顶点手部接触。
AI.result: 作者报告：在ARCTIC上，EgoHSI3R的世界空间手部关节误差在所评估方法中最低；推理速度快于现有世界空间手部重建流程；相机与场景重建精度有竞争力。摘要未报告具体误差或速度数值、基线名称、硬件条件及统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，单一前馈、因果在线的网络有望同时恢复手、相机与场景，为具身学习提供共享3D世界中的手-场景交互重建。证据边界：摘要只给出ARCTIC上的“最低误差”声明和相对推理速度、竞争性精度等定性结果，未提供数值、与哪些基线比较、硬件/实时性指标或统计检验；未读全文，不能推断更多能力。

key_results.evidence_quote: while offering faster inference than existing world-space hand reconstruction pipelines and competitive camera and scene reconstruction accuracy.

ee7356924eda44cd3ee0e563e32bb9d93c978fed.title: Adaptive Coverage Algorithms for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks in Dynamic Worlds
ee7356924eda44cd3ee0e563e32bb9d93c978fed.comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference (URTC)
ee7356924eda44cd3ee0e563e32bb9d93c978fed.summary: This paper extends an existing framework for the coordination of mobile agents in unknown worlds, by considering the possibility of dynamic instability. In the original problem, known as the Partially Observable Cooperative Guard Art Gallery Problem (POCGAGP) ( arXiv:2512.09495 ), the multi-agent system must establish a communication network which completely covers an initially unknown constrained space. However, the POCGAGP fails to account for the unpredictability often seen in real-world deployment. To address this, the dynamic case (DPOCGAGP) introduces two settings which can influence the mobile network during deployment: Agent Loss and World Change, which represent dynamic changes to the world. Within this study, we present advancements to two state-of-the-art algorithms, the Centralized Agent-Directed Exploration for Network Coverage (CADENCE), and its decentralized analogue, DADENCE, to provide solutions in these cases. We then compare their performance against another state-of-the-art benchmark algorithm, and show that the adapted algorithms outperform across our benchmark test set, which comprises over 4500 test cases of varied size and structure.

AI.tldr: 把只考虑静态未知世界的POCGAGP扩展为动态情形DPOCGAGP（含Agent Loss与世界变化两种设定），并改造CADENCE与DADENCE两种算法；作者称改进算法在超过4500个测试用例的基准集上优于另一个当前最优基线，但摘要未给出任何数值。
AI.motivation: 原POCGAGP要求多机器人系统在初始未知的受限空间中建立完全覆盖的通信网络，但没有考虑真实部署中常见的不可预测性/动态不稳定，因此需要能应对部署期动态变化的方法。
AI.method: 输入是未知受限空间中的多机器人系统，需要在部分可观测条件下协调并形成覆盖该空间的通信网络。与原有静态设定相比，方法把问题改写为动态版本DPOCGAGP，引入两类部署期扰动：Agent Loss（机器人丢失）与World Change（世界变化）；在此设定下对已有的集中式算法CADENCE及其去中心化版本DADENCE进行改造，使其在这两种动态情形下仍能给出协调与建网方案。输出是适用于动态情形的覆盖/通信网络协调解，并与另一个当前最优基准算法对比性能。
AI.result: 作者报告：改造后的CADENCE与DADENCE在一个包含超过4500个不同规模与结构测试用例的基准测试集上，整体优于另一个当前最优基准算法，即作者主张SOTA；摘要未报告任何具体指标数值、单位或相对/绝对提升幅度。评测是仿真式测试集还是真实机器人，摘要未报告。除“整体优于基线”外，摘要未区分Agent Loss与世界变化两种设定各自的胜负或退化程度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把多机器人在未知受限空间的覆盖式组网，从静态设定推进到包含机器人丢失和世界变化的动态设定，并说明对既有集中的/分散的协调算法做相应改造可在上述扰动下维持可用解，多智能体通信覆盖的鲁棒协调可因此获得一个可比较的动态问题定义。证据边界：以上均为作者自述，且摘要只给出“在超过4500个测试用例的基准集上优于另一个当前最优算法”的定性结论，没有数值、没有说明仿真/真机区别、没有逐设定结果，因此无法判断提升幅度、稳定性代价与部署可行性。
AI.core_method: 把静态覆盖式组网问题改写为含“机器人丢失”和“世界变化”的动态版本，并据此改造集中式CADENCE与去中心化DADENCE两种协调算法。

5e968698cdc48712f51d5b756985377f0b1579b0.title: Learning Stabilizing Latent Feedback Controllers via Multi-Step Backward Losses
5e968698cdc48712f51d5b756985377f0b1579b0.summary: Can learned latent dynamics models support the design of feedback controllers that provably stabilize the original system? For linear time-invariant systems, we show that learning linear autoencoders and latent dynamics with multi-step prediction-reconstruction losses $\unicode{x2014}$ which we term "backward losses" as they encourage latent trajectories to reconstruct full state trajectories $\unicode{x2014}$ provably recovers the structure needed for stabilization. Specifically, a sufficiently long reconstruction horizon ensures that a minimum ${H}_\infty$-norm controller designed using the learned latent model stabilizes the original system through output-feedback via the corresponding encoder, provided the latent dimension is large enough to capture all non-stable modes of the underlying system. We also show why both reconstruction and a multi-step horizon are essential: forward prediction losses that require only low prediction error along latent trajectories admit global loss minimizers that discard unstable modes regardless of horizon length, while single-step reconstruction losses can yield latent models whose stabilizing controllers fail to stabilize the original system. Finally, experiments on a non-linear flexible-arm system illustrate the practical implications of our results for learning non-linear autoencoders and latent dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文追问：学到的潜动力学模型能否支撑可证明稳定的反馈控制器设计。作者对线性时不变（LTI）系统证明，用多步"反向损失"（预测-重构）训练线性自编码器与潜动力学，可恢复稳定所需结构；并在非线性柔性臂系统上做示意性实验。摘要未报告任何数值结果。
AI.motivation: 用学习的潜动力学模型做控制时，缺少"所设计的控制器能否稳定原系统"的保证。作者指出，常见做法（只要求潜轨迹上低预测误差的正向预测损失）存在会丢弃不稳定模态的全局极小值，因此损失设计本身可能破坏后续控制的可稳定化条件。
AI.method: 输入是系统状态轨迹。方法同时学习线性自编码器与潜动力学，训练目标是多步预测-重构损失（作者称为"backward losses"），即让潜轨迹重构完整的状态轨迹；随后在学到的潜模型上设计最小 H∞ 范数控制器，并通过对应编码器以输出反馈作用到原系统。相对被比较的损失形式（正向预测损失、单步重构损失），关键改动是损失中同时包含重构项与多步时域，以及重构时域的长度。
AI.result: 作者报告的是定性与理论结果，摘要未给出任何任务指标或数值：足够长的重构时域可保证用潜模型设计的最小 H∞ 范数控制器经编码器输出反馈稳定原系统，前提是潜维度足以覆盖原系统的全部非稳定模态。作者还报告反向的论证：只要求潜轨迹低预测误差的正向预测损失，无论时域多长都存在丢弃不稳定模态的全局极小值；单步重构损失可能得到其稳定控制器无法稳定原系统的潜模型。实验仅为非线性柔性臂系统上的示意。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型的意义在于：潜动力学模型的价值不只在预测精度，训练损失的构造（是否需要重构、时域是否多步）直接决定下游控制器能否获得稳定性保证。证据边界明确：可证明结论仅针对 LTI 系统，非线性情形只有柔性臂上的示意实验，摘要未报告数值、仿真/真机条件与对比基线，因此不能据此推断真实机器人上的稳定性或性能。
AI.core_method: 用多步预测-重构（反向）损失训练线性自编码器与潜动力学，使潜状态可重构完整状态轨迹，再在潜空间设计最小 H∞ 控制器并经编码器做输出反馈。

key_results.finding: 作者证明：当重构时域足够长、且潜维度足以捕获原系统所有非稳定模态时，用学习到的潜模型设计的最小 H∞ 范数控制器可经对应编码器以输出反馈稳定原系统（无量化指标）。
key_results.setting: 线性时不变系统的理论结果；任务、基准与数值指标摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: a sufficiently long reconstruction horizon ensures that a minimum ${H}_\infty$-norm controller designed using the learned latent model stabilizes the original system through output-feedback via the corresponding encoder, provided the latent dimension is large enough to capture all non-stable modes of the underlying system.

key_results.finding: 作者报告负向结论：仅要求潜轨迹低预测误差的正向预测损失存在丢弃不稳定模态的全局极小值，且与时域长度无关；单步重构损失可能产生稳定控制器无法稳定原系统的潜模型。
key_results.setting: LTI 系统的理论分析；指标与实验条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: forward prediction losses that require only low prediction error along latent trajectories admit global loss minimizers that discard unstable modes regardless of horizon length, while single-step reconstruction losses can yield latent models whose stabilizing controllers fail to stabilize the original system.

key_results.finding: 作者称在非线性柔性臂系统上的实验展示了结论对学习非线性自编码器与潜动力学的实践意义（无量化指标）。
key_results.setting: 非线性柔性臂系统；摘要未报告是仿真还是真机、也未报告任务指标、基线与数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: experiments on a non-linear flexible-arm system illustrate the practical implications of our results for learning non-linear autoencoders and latent dynamics.

limitations: 作者报告的可证明结论限于线性时不变系统；非线性情形未给出理论保证。

067a4891de8f8419418036885e089514c0c3cbfe.title: Physically Constrained Kinematic Calibration for High-Precision Robotic Needle Guidance
067a4891de8f8419418036885e089514c0c3cbfe.summary: Percutaneous needle insertion is a common practice in minimally invasive procedures whose clinical success depends on accurate needle placement. However, achieving the necessary precision is a challenge for manual operators. Robotic assistance can improve targeting accuracy and reduce operator dependence, but residual millimeter-scale errors persist because nominal kinematic models do not fully represent the physical manipulator. This paper presents a robust bound-constrained kinematic calibration method designed to improve positional accuracy for a 6-Degree-of-Freedom (6-DoF) robotic needle-guidance manipulator. The approach uses physically plausible parameter ranges to regularize a compact 19-parameter geometric identification model. By treating these bounds as active optimization constraints rather than mere numerical safeguards, the framework effectively mitigates parameter coupling and overfitting, ensuring highly stable parameter identification. In simulation, the proposed method reduced end-effector Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) from 3.422 mm to 0.690 mm (a 79.8% improvement). In benchtop hardware experiments, the calibrated model achieved sub-millimeter validation accuracy, including 0.865 mm RMSE in experimental trajectory validation and 0.610 mm RMSE in a coordinate-lattice verification task. These results demonstrate that physically constrained kinematic calibration can enhance robotic needle-targeting accuracy, establishing a high-precision foundation for future clinical applications.

AI.tldr: 针对6自由度机器人穿刺针引导臂，作者用物理合理的参数范围作为主动约束来正则化19参数几何标定模型，抑制参数耦合与过拟合；仿真中末端RMSE从3.422 mm降至0.690 mm，台架实验中验证RMSE达亚毫米级。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，经皮穿刺的临床成功依赖针尖放置精度，但人工操作者难以达到所需精度；机器人辅助可提高靶向精度并降低对操作者的依赖，然而由于名义运动学模型无法完全刻画物理机械臂，仍残留毫米级误差。
AI.method: 输入是6自由度穿刺针引导机械臂的运动学/几何误差数据；方法将物理上合理的参数取值范围作为主动优化约束（bound constraints）而非单纯数值保护，用以正则化一个紧凑的19参数几何辨识模型，从而缓解参数耦合与过拟合、稳定参数辨识；输出是一组经约束标定后的几何参数（标定模型），用于提高末端定位精度。相对于名义运动学模型这一基线，改变的是误差参数的辨识方式与结果。
AI.result: 作者报告：仿真中末端RMSE由3.422 mm降至0.690 mm（79.8%改善，相对降幅）；台架硬件实验中，标定模型达到亚毫米级验证精度，包括实验轨迹验证0.865 mm RMSE与坐标点阵验证任务0.610 mm RMSE。摘要未报告与其它标定方法的对比、样本量或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：把物理可行性作为优化约束嵌入运动学标定，可在机械臂精度这一底层环节获得稳定的亚毫米级改进，为后续临床穿刺应用提供精度基础。证据限度在于：定量结果仅来自仿真与台架实验，摘要未报告临床或活体验证，也未给出与其它标定基线的横向比较，因此不能推断临床可用性。
AI.core_method: 把物理合理的参数范围当作主动优化约束，正则化19参数几何辨识模型以稳定参数估计。

key_results.evidence_quote: In simulation, the proposed method reduced end-effector Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) from 3.422 mm to 0.690 mm (a 79.8% improvement).

key_results.finding: 台架硬件实验中，实验轨迹验证达到0.865 mm RMSE。
key_results.setting: 台式硬件实验（benchtop hardware experiments），6自由度穿刺针引导机械臂；摘要未报告对比基线。
key_results.evidence_quote: including 0.865 mm RMSE in experimental trajectory validation

key_results.setting: 台架硬件上的坐标点阵验证任务；摘要未报告对比基线。
key_results.evidence_quote: and 0.610 mm RMSE in a coordinate-lattice verification task

limitations: 摘要未报告临床、活体或患者试验结果，仅提及为“future clinical applications”建立基础（作者暗示尚未进入临床应用）。
摘要未报告与其它标定方法（如无约束/最小二乘标定）的对比结果，因此“高精度”是在缺少横向基线的条件下陈述的。
摘要未报告样本量、重复次数、统计显著性、参数范围的具体取值及计算开销；这些属于摘要未报告的信息，并非说明方法缺乏相应能力。

a5fc4b22fb1cc624039524e4551261b0ae205e66.title: ObjectGuidedMap: An Object-Aware Model for Robust Bird's Eye View Map Prediction in High-Occlusion Scenarios
a5fc4b22fb1cc624039524e4551261b0ae205e66.summary: Accurate BEV map prediction is a critical component of autonomous driving systems, enabling downstream planning and control. Recent approaches such as Mask2Map achieve strong performance by predicting vectorized, instance-level map elements directly from multi-view images. However, existing BEV map prediction models operate largely independently of object-level scene understanding, despite the fact that traffic participants frequently occlude or implicitly encode information about road geometry. In this work, we propose a multitask architecture that jointly predicts BEV maps and 3D objects, explicitly enabling information exchange between the two tasks. Building upon Mask2Map, we introduce an object detection branch and incorporate cross-task feature fusion at both the BEV feature level and the instance-query level via deformable attention and cross-attention mechanisms. This design allows map instances to leverage object context while remaining robust to occlusions caused by traffic participants. Experimental results on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently improves BEV map prediction accuracy, with particularly significant gains of 21% mAP in scenes containing heavy object occlusion.

AI.tldr: 在 Mask2Map 基础上提出多任务架构 ObjectGuidedMap，联合预测 BEV 地图与 3D 物体并在 BEV 特征与实例查询两级做跨任务特征融合，作者报告在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 上一致提升 BEV 地图预测精度，重遮挡场景 mAP 提升 21%。
AI.motivation: 现有 BEV 地图预测模型（如 Mask2Map）虽能从多视图图像直接预测矢量化、实例级地图元素并取得强性能，但基本独立于物体级场景理解，而交通参与者常遮挡道路几何或隐含编码道路几何信息。
AI.method: 输入是多视图图像；方法在 Mask2Map 之上新增一个 3D 物体检测分支，并在地图与物体两个任务间交换信息：在 BEV 特征级与实例查询级分别通过可变形注意力（deformable attention）与交叉注意力（cross-attention）进行跨任务特征融合，使地图实例可利用物体上下文。输出是联合预测的 BEV 地图与 3D 物体，目标是让地图预测在交通参与者造成遮挡时更鲁棒。
AI.result: 作者报告在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 数据集上该方法一致提升 BEV 地图预测精度，并在重遮挡场景中取得尤其显著的提升：mAP 提升 21%。摘要未报告具体基线数值、评估划分或其他量化对比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提示物体级理解可为 BEV 地图预测提供互补上下文，尤其在遮挡条件下。证据仅限摘要所述的 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 结果与 21% mAP 提升描述，未提供真实车端部署、延迟或统计显著性证据。
AI.core_method: 在 Mask2Map 上并联一个 3D 物体检测分支，并在 BEV 特征级与实例查询级用可变形注意力和交叉注意力融合物体与地图信息。

key_results.setting: nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 数据集上的 BEV 地图预测；基线为摘要所述 Mask2Map 类方法，具体基线数值与实验划分摘要未报告
key_results.evidence_quote: Experimental results on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently improves BEV map prediction accuracy, with particularly significant gains of 21% mAP in scenes containing heavy object occlusion.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何作者明示的局限（如失败场景或误差分析），此项为 not reported in the abstract。
